meta.strategy: 7.2 JP PF AST — practical burst + 30s DoT
meta.author: FF14 Timeline Voice Coach
meta.description: Standalone M7S H1 Astrologian plan with practical rotation reminders. The raid-burst profile uses opener, ~120s, ~240s, then delays the 6-minute window to ~370s because the boss is untargetable from about 352.1s to 369.5s; following raid-burst windows continue around 490s and 610s. DoT reminders follow a practical ~30-second refresh cycle. The refresh that would fall inside the first forced downtime is delayed to the boss return around 163.5s, then the cycle continues from that reapplication. DoT calls are merged into nearby AST healing calls when concise. All cues are enabled and the active <=2000ms collision count is zero.
